mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_commodity_outbox WHERE event_status IN (0, 2) AND next_retry_time <= #{now} ORDER BY event_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_commodity_outbox SET event_status = 1, sent_time = #{sentTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND event_status IN (0, 2)
UPDATE t_commodity_outbox SET event_status = 2, retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND event_status IN (0, 2)
